title: Mohini, the Beautiful Woman on the Night Road
seed: Mohini is a seductress spirit in Sinhala folklore, said to appear to lone travellers on empty roads, sometimes in white, sometimes with unnatural beauty and feet that do not quite touch the ground. Tell it as a first-person night-drive story told by a driver's relative.
setting: empty jungle road in the Sri Lankan dry zone at night, teak forest, cracked asphalt

title: Riri Yaka, the Blood Demon of the Village
seed: Riri Yaka is the blood-drinking demon of Sinhala folk belief, one of the best-known yaka figures and tied to the Sanni Yakuma healing ritual. Build a village story about a sickness, a family and a night ritual, treated with respect for the tradition.
setting: remote Sri Lankan village at night, oil lamps, clay houses, coconut palms

title: Kalu Kumaraya, the Black Prince
seed: Kalu Kumaraya is a dark spirit in Sri Lankan folk belief, linked to possession and to rituals and offerings. Tell a story about a young woman, a family that dismisses the warnings, and the night a ritual specialist is called.
setting: old family house, hill-country village, mist and kerosene lamp light

title: Maha Sohon, the Graveyard Giant
seed: Maha Sohon (Mahasona) is a giant graveyard demon of Sinhala folklore. Tell a story of a night shift worker or a funeral party passing an old cemetery, focused on dread and the old rule never to look back.
setting: old village cemetery at night, giant silhouette of a banyan tree, ground mist

title: The Nittaewo, Sri Lanka's Lost People of the Caves
seed: The Nittaewo are a legendary race of small, fierce cave-dwelling humanoids in Sri Lankan oral tradition, mentioned in accounts by Robert Knox and later colonial writers, said to have been wiped out by the Veddas. Present it as legend, with investigators arriving in remote southeast jungle.
setting: remote southeastern Sri Lankan jungle, rock caves, dusk, dense scrub

title: Gini Bola, the Fire Balls over the Paddy Fields
seed: Villagers describe floating balls of fire drifting over fields and cemeteries at night, called gini bola. Tell a story from the point of view of a farmer who follows a light across the paddy.
setting: paddy field at night, small floating orange light, distant jungle edge

title: The Night a Tovil Went Wrong
seed: Tovil is a traditional all-night healing ritual with drummers, dancers and masks. Write a fictional story, clearly framed as fiction inspired by tradition, about the night a ritual dancer noticed one extra dancer in the circle. Be respectful of the tradition.
setting: night ritual in a village courtyard, torchlight, drums, painted masks

title: The Masks of Ambalangoda
seed: Ambalangoda on the southern coast is famous for traditional mask carving, including the Sanni demon masks for the eighteen diseases. Tell a fictional story about an antique mask bought by a collector.
setting: workshop of carved wooden masks, coastal town, humid night, rain

title: The Kattadiya's Last Warning
seed: A kattadiya is a traditional ritual healer in Sri Lanka. Tell a story about a skeptical city family renting a house in a village, and an old kattadiya who tells them what not to do after dark.
setting: rented village house, veranda, oil lamp, forest edge behind the house

title: The Night Mail Train to Badulla
seed: Hill-country railway lines through tunnels and tea country carry many travellers' tales. Tell a fictional urban legend about a passenger who boards the last night train and sees a stop that is not on any timetable.
setting: old Sri Lankan railway carriage at night, tea estates, mist, tunnels

title: Lovina and the Governor's House
seed: A well-known coastal Colombo legend says a British governor in the early 19th century loved a local dancer named Lovina, hence the name Mount Lavinia, and that a secret tunnel linked them. Retell it as a romantic-gothic legend with a haunting twist, clearly framed as legend.
setting: colonial-era seaside mansion, cliff above the Indian Ocean, moonlit corridors

title: The Women on the Wall at Sigiriya
seed: The frescoes at Sigiriya, built by King Kashyapa in the 5th century, show women (apsaras) painted on the rock. Write a respectful atmospheric story, clearly fictional, about a night watchman and the paintings. Do not claim real hauntings occurred.
setting: Sigiriya rock fortress at night, mirror wall, moonlit rock face, stairs

title: Footsteps in the Dutch Church of Colombo
seed: Wolvendaal Church in Colombo is an 18th-century Dutch Reformed church with old graves inside. Write a clearly fictional story about a caretaker locking up on a rainy evening. Do not claim real documented hauntings.
setting: old Dutch colonial church interior, stone floor graves, thunderstorm

title: The Line Room at the End of the Estate
seed: Tea estate 'line rooms' housed plantation workers. Write a fictional story about a young estate assistant manager who hears singing from an abandoned line room, handled with respect for the workers' history.
setting: tea estate at night, abandoned line rooms, cold mist, hill country

title: What Walks the Hanthana Ridge
seed: The Hanthana mountain range above Kandy is popular with hikers and university students. Write a fictional campfire story about a group that loses the trail at dusk.
setting: forested ridge above Kandy, dusk, trail disappearing in mist

title: The Well That Answered Back
seed: Old village wells feature in many Sri Lankan stories. Write a fictional story about a boy who drops a coin in an abandoned well and hears his name called back.
setting: abandoned village well in a coconut grove, evening light fading, crows

title: The Preta at the Edge of the Lamp Light
seed: In Buddhist-influenced folk belief, a preta is a hungry ghost bound by craving. Write a thoughtful, eerie fictional story about a family that forgot to offer alms for a deceased relative.
setting: traditional Sri Lankan house, a dinner table, one empty chair, oil lamp, rain outside

title: The Huniyam Charm Under the Doorstep
seed: Huniyam refers to curses or black-magic charms in Sri Lankan folk belief. Write a fictional story about new homeowners who find a buried charm under the front step.
setting: newly bought old house in a suburb, front doorstep, digging at dusk, neighbours watching

title: Kuveni's Curse
seed: In the Mahavamsa legend, Kuveni, a yakkini queen, was abandoned by Prince Vijaya and is said to have cursed him. Retell it as a dark legend, with faithful reference to the chronicle's outline and no invented historical claims.
setting: ancient legendary Lanka, jungle, moonlit palace ruins, spinning wheel

title: The Night Guard of Jaffna Fort
seed: Jaffna Fort was built by the Portuguese, expanded by the Dutch, and damaged in the war. Write a clearly fictional night guard story with respect for the area's real history of loss.
setting: old star fort at night, sea wind, ramparts and cannons, lone lantern

title: The Hitchhiker of Ella Gap
seed: Write a fictional story of a tuk-tuk driver who picks up a quiet passenger near the Ella Gap at night and a fare that never gets paid.
setting: mountain road at night near Ella, tuk-tuk headlights, fog, a lone figure by the road

title: The Last Bell at the Old School
seed: Write a fictional story about a night watchman in an old rural school who hears the bell ring at midnight, a story many Sri Lankans will recognise from school tales.
setting: old colonial school building at night, empty classrooms, brass bell, corridor

title: The Boatman on the Kalu Ganga
seed: Write a fictional story about a ferry boatman on a river at night and a passenger who asks to be taken to a bank where there is no village.
setting: river at night in lowland Sri Lanka, small wooden boat, lantern, mist over water
